sword.name: Training Sword
sword.desc: A plain wooden blade. Press J to swing (the B button on a phone).

shadowglass.name: Shadowglass Blade
shadowglass.desc: A blade of black glass. It hums when bats are near. Press J to swing.
shadowglass.pitch: a blade of black glass that drinks the light

moonreaper.name: Moonreaper
moonreaper.desc: A pale curved blade that glows in the dark. Press J to swing.
moonreaper.pitch: a pale moon-bright scythe-blade for the deepest dark
